vulnerability_type: Privileged Fee and Transaction Limit Manipulation

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the Plenty contract.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setTaxFeePercent()` function with a high value like 50. This demonstrates the ability to unilaterally and silently change critical contract parameters. This can be used to set user transaction fees to an exorbitant rate, for example, by also calling `setLiquidityFeePercent(50)` to make the total fee on all transfers 100%.
